name: arthurpower
description: Curated engineering constraint plugin (v0.7.0). 27 Skills grouped into 6 families: (1) S1-S6 governance - bounded-context-guardian (S1, module boundaries), defensive-contract-validator (S2, 5 boundary classes), error-handling-enforcer (S3, typed exception rules), complexity-anti-drift (S5, threshold + refactor pattern), minimal-change-verifier (S6, 1 commit = 1 logical task); (2) Architecture & planning - architecture-change-reviewer (5-verdict pre-impl gate), writing-plans (ordered task decomposition); (3) Process gates - verification-before-completion (evidence before claims), systematic-debugging (4-phase root cause), defend-claim (claim-time anti-self-cert gate, 5 hook enforcement); (4) Dispatch - dispatching-parallel-agents (subagent orchestration); (5) Engineering disciplines - spec-driven-development, frontend-ui-engineering, performance-optimization, security-and-hardening, context7-lookup; (6) v0.5.0 added context7-lookup. v0.6.0 fixes a stdin-hang bug in the 5 PostToolUse defend-claim hooks (they now delegate to a shared hooks/lib/read-stdin-with-timeout.cjs grace-timeout reader instead of blocking on for-await), and adds 2 agents (arthurpower-audit-agent, arthurpower-dispatcher) + 2 commands (/audit, /fanout) that were previously missing from the plugin manifest; (7) code-review (改后预 commit 审查, v-code-review CLI 集成, Fowler 12 smell, Standards+Spec 双轴, High/Medium/Low verdict).
